cases.evidence: Identity-bound JodiUSA grant, all 27 features available, $0 billing UI, no provider call/invoice, hidden paid checkout, no auto-consent and revocation/suspension protections pass. Full feature journeys remain open.

Existing catalog unchanged; successful signed test activation/renewal and expired plan denial pass. Other tenants cannot obtain the free grant or purchase its internal plan. Complete paid feature matrix remains open.

Existing usage/feature regression suite passes; free grant removes commercial caps without overriding safety/operator controls. Exhaustive paid quota boundaries and resource capacity are not certified.

Browser cross-tenant billing denial and tenant-host console isolation pass. Identity spoofing, copied grant, tenant setting spoof, unpaid feature switch and internal-plan purchase are denied in database tests. Full endpoint matrix remains open.

Standard Checkout selected explicitly. Actual hosted test payment returns to application, signed callback activates correct tenant, monthly renewal and annual interval/unpaid denial pass. Complete owner-initiated plan-management journey remains open.

Registered public HTTPS callback with production routes/ASGI processes signed Stripe events. Unsigned request400 and missing secret503, duplicate/concurrent/stale refund regressions pass. Retry after route activation succeeds. Complete out-of-order lifecycle and operational alerting remain open.

Scheduled cancellation retains current access; actual test-clock natural expiry deactivates local access and removes paid tier, signed deletion recorded. Explicit cancellation also passes. Customer-facing cancellation-management journey remains open.

Real partial/full and renewal-specific refunds reconcile exact ledger totals through registered HTTPS. Concurrent duplicate/stale refund regressions pass. Refunds do not implicitly cancel access. Asynchronous pending/failed refund recovery remains open.
